description: This file defines a Validator class responsible for validating input data against specified rules within a human resource management system (OrangeHRM). It handles rule collection, error management, and validation logic, integrating with respect validation rules and custom exceptions.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Provides static methods to validate arrays of input values against specified rules, handling exceptions and error collection.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates input values against a collection of parameter rules. Throws exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: getOnlyNecessaryValues
methods.description: Filters input values to retain only those necessary according to the provided rules, excluding specified keys.
